length_limits.notes: No length limit is stated on the submission page.

figure_spec.notes: PICT, BMP, Excel and PSD files are not accepted and must be converted to PDF or an accepted format first.

reference_style.style: Not addressed on the submission page.

submission_steps: register on the site and supply an institutional affiliation
upload one PDF of text and figures, or a Word file plus separate figure files, at submit.biorxiv.org
supply the full author list with affiliations, corresponding-author contact details, funding sources and a competing-interests declaration
expect basic screening for non-scientific content and health or biosecurity risk

template.notes: No Word or LaTeX template is mentioned on the page.

license_of_summary_source.statement: Authors choose a posting licence from CC BY, CC BY-NC, CC BY-ND, CC BY-NC-ND, CC0 or no reuse, and keep copyright in every case; the page states no licence for its own text.
